verses.pali: Yo ca āpattiyā anāpattisaññī, yo ca anāpattiyā āpattisaññī.
verses.english: One who perceives an offense as a non-offense, and one who perceives a non-offense as an offense.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ āsavā vaḍḍhantī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two whose defilements grow.”
